ei.title: One Calendar for Work and Life
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Research shows that people who work have two calendars: one for work and one for their personal lives. Although it may seem sensible, having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions. To check if something is missing, you will find yourself checking your to-do lists multiple times. Instead, organize all of your tasks in one place. It doesn't matter if you use digital or paper media. It's okay to keep your professional and personal tasks in one place. This will give you a good idea of how time is divided between work and home. This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

일하는 사람들은 두 개의 달력을 가지고 있다.

[조건] (1) calendars, have, people, two, who, work를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.analysis:
본문: 'Research shows that people who work have two calendars' — 주격 관계대명사 who가 선행사 people을 수식. 주어 people(복수) + 복수 동사 have

[조건 검증] people(1) who(2) work(3) have(4) two(5) calendars(6) = 6단어 ✅
det.tip: people who work = 일하는 사람들 (who = 주격 관계대명사)

questions.wa: people who work have two calendars
accept: people who work have two calendars

questions.passage: Research __________ (show) that people who work have two calendars: one for work and one for their personal lives. Although it may seem sensible, having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: show(동사) → shows(3인칭 단수 현재): 주어 Research는 불가산명사로 단수 취급하므로 동사에 -s를 붙여 shows
det.tip: Research(불가산, 단수 취급) → shows

questions.passage: Research shows that people who work have two calendars: one for work and one for their personal lives. Although it may seem sensible, __________. To check if something is missing, you will find yourself checking your to-do lists multiple times. Instead, organize all of your tasks in one place. It doesn't matter if you use digital or paper media. It's okay to keep your professional and personal tasks in one place. This will give you a good idea of how time is divided between work and home. This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

업무와 개인 생활을 위한 두 개의 별도 달력을 갖는 것은 주의 산만으로 이어질 수 있다.

[조건] (1) and, calendars, can, distractions, for, having, lead, life, personal, separate, to, two, work를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 13단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions
det.analysis:
본문: 'having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions' — 동명사 주어(having) + 조동사 can + lead to(~로 이어지다)

[조건 검증] having(1) two(2) separate(3) calendars(4) for(5) work(6) and(7) personal(8) life(9) can(10) lead(11) to(12) distractions(13) = 13단어 ✅
det.tip: 동명사 주어 + can lead to = ~하는 것은 …로 이어질 수 있다

questions.wa: having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions
accept: having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions

questions.passage: Research shows that people who work have two calendars: one for work and one for their personal lives. Although it may seem sensible, having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions. To check if something is missing, you will find yourself checking your to-do lists multiple times. Instead, organize all of your tasks in one place. It doesn't matter if you use digital or paper media. It's okay to keep your professional and personal tasks in one place. This will give you a good idea of how time is divided between work and home. __________.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (14단어, 영어로)

이것은 당신이 어떤 일이 가장 중요한지에 대해 정보에 입각한 결정을 내리게 할 것이다.

[단어] about, allow, are, decisions, important, informed, make, most, tasks, This, to, which, will, you

det.korean: This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important
det.analysis: 본문: 'This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important' — allow + O(you) + to부정사. 전치사 about + 간접의문문(which tasks are most important)
det.tip: allow + O + to V / about + 간접의문문

questions.wa: This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important
accept: This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important

questions.passage: Research shows that people who work have two calendars: one for work and one for their personal lives. Although it may seem sensible, having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions. To check if something is missing, you will find yourself checking your to-do lists multiple times. Instead, organize all of your tasks in one place. It doesn't matter if __________. It's okay to keep your professional and personal tasks in one place. This will give you a good idea of how time is divided between work and home. This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

당신은 디지털 매체나 종이 매체를 사용한다.

[조건] (1) digital, media, or, paper, use, you를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.analysis:
본문: 'It doesn't matter if you use digital or paper media' — 간접의문문 if절 안의 주어(you) + 동사(use) + 목적어(digital or paper media). 등위접속사 or로 두 매체 연결

[조건 검증] you(1) use(2) digital(3) or(4) paper(5) media(6) = 6단어 ✅
det.tip: A or B = A 또는 B (등위접속사 or)

questions.wa: you use digital or paper media
accept: you use digital or paper media
